newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Zim Israel Navigation names new CEO, chairman.
newsitem.headline: Zim Israel Navigation names new CEO, chairman.

text.p: Yoram Sebba has been named acting president of Zim Israel Navigation and Shoul Eisenberg its chairman in a management shakeup this week, the company said.

Eisenberg, who is chairman of Israel Corp, which controls 51 percent of Zim, replaces Moshe Arens, who resigned as chairman on Wednesday night. Sebba, until now head of planning, engineering and information systems at Zim, replaces Matty Morgenstern, who resigned earlier on Wednesday.

Sources close to the company said Eisenberg and his son Ervin, who is CEO of Israel Corp, are planning a major reorganisation of Zim, one of the world's 10 largest shipping companies. They said Sebba is likely to be named permanent president but that the Eisenbergs would become more directly involved in day-to-day management of the company.

Morgenstern headed Zim for 12 years, but sources said Shoul Eisenberg became concerned about the company's direction in recent months. In the third-quarter, Zim lost $6.3 million on revenues of $351.1 million, bringing its nine-month loss to $2.1 million.

The remaining shares in Zim are held by the government of Israel. Zim is believed to be one of the companies that the government is considering selling this year as part of its privatisation programme.
